# VAO CLI 0.2.0

VAO CLI 0.2.0 is the first public release of the reference client for the
[Virtual Acoustic Object (VAO) Standard 0.4.0](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22122774).
The archived software release is identified by
[10.5281/zenodo.22133810](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22133810).

It provides DOI resolution, semantic inspection and selection, bounded remote carrier
inspection, verified selective acquisition, full carrier validation and download,
local metadata revision, community cataloging, and a loopback resolver interface.
Operations that make a VAO 0.4.0 conformance claim use the authoritative validator from
the released standard checkout.

The attached source archive, wheel, and checksum file are prepared from the signed
release tag. The Zenodo integration is non-mutating; no command creates, edits,
publishes, submits, or deletes a Zenodo record.

Affiliations identify the developer and do not imply institutional endorsement.
